node.title: L1 root-free rational-Q projective packing
node.statement: After the boundary planted-root descent with r<k, put j=m-r, d=k-r, G=Wbar1 P_S-Nbar1, and V=span(G,W1 F[X]_<d). If the exact cell is nonempty, V has dimension d+1, is gcd-trivial on the punctured domain, and its full projective split-locator intersection is exactly the boundary cell: the infinity hyperplane contains no split locator. Distinct degree-j locator root sets intersect in at most d-1 points, so the cell has size at most floor(binom(n-r,d)/binom(m-r,d)). At linear locator density this is exp(O(d)), paying fixed d and d=o(n) at the corresponding asymptotic reserve scale, but it is not row-sharp for d=Theta(n).
